title: Resolution urging Albany to ban AI in pre-high school classrooms
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, S.10133/A.9190, which would prohibit most use of artificial intelligence in classrooms before high school. It cites a 2026 RAND survey finding 71% of students used AI tools for schoolwork but only 45% of principals reported having related policies. It also notes the city's Department of Education has yet to finalize its own AI guidelines for schools.
